logp.method_description: Purified 99mTc-labeled ligand (50 μCi) was added into 3.6 mL of n-octanol and 3.0 mL of PBS (0.05 M, pH 7.4). The mixture was vortexed for 3 min and then centrifuged for 5 min at 3000 rpm. Samples from n-octanol (50 μL) and PBS (500 μL) were carefully taken in triplicate and measured by a γ-counter (WALLAC/Wizard 1470, USA). Samples from the n-octanol layer (2.0 mL) were repartitioned until consistent distribution coefficient values were obtained.
